title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit325, int4 KV, 1M context (2.18M pool)
summary: Full GLM-5.3 on six DGX Sparks at TP=6 with upstream gr8: exlr8 bit325 (v0.6), int4 KV with a 2,179,072-token pool (1,048,576 max context, SHARE_LIMIT=65,536), zero-copy shared prefix pages, MTP=3 drafting with confidence stopping, bit-exact kernel paths plus MoE union cap (48 quality default, 32 fast preset), 8 concurrent sessions, 7.2+ GiB free RAM per box, RealMark 1,431.9 Grade A (C=4 1,571.3, 99.2% cache hit), 2,257 tok/s 128K cold prefill (+19.7% vs v1.1.1), and live-proven 4x250K concurrency (998K resident tokens).

configs.label: TP=6
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: prompt + max_tokens · live-proven: 4x250K (998,413 resident tok, 4/4 needles, 99.9% cached)

quality.name: RealMark RIPAL (C=1/2/4)
quality.value: 1,431.9 Grade A (16/16 all lanes, 99.2% cache hit)

configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-28 on kindlingai/gr8 main (530312e6) across 6 DGX Sparks (200G switch), bit325 experts (3.25 bpw, v0.6 @ 3e388b45), int4 KV (CAP=2,179,072, 6,528 pages/rank, MAX_MODEL_LEN=1,048,576, SHARE_LIMIT=65,536, SESS=8, GR8_KV_SHARE_PAGES=1), MTP=3 with confidence stopping, MOE_UNION_CAP=48 quality default. bench/bench.py default level (GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages, 0% throttle): smoke 14/14, count 3/3, cache 419/420, needle 128K (131,000 tok) PASS, 0 suspect; cold prefill 8K 2,296 / 32K 2,428 / 128K 2,257 tok/s (+19.7% at 128K vs v1.1.1; cached 128K TTFT 0.22 s, 7.7x faster). Official RealMark C=1/2/4 (Thinking OFF, --probe): 1,431.9 Grade A (C=1 1,312.1 / C=2 1,424.1 / C=4 1,571.3; 16/16 done on all lanes; 99.23% prefix cache hit across 305K active C=4 context; C=1 prefill floor 2,387 tok/s; idle TTFT 0.33 s). Lowest MemAvailable 7.25 GiB during bench, 7.42 GiB during RealMark. Fast mode (MOE_UNION_CAP=32) and 998K live 4x250K proof measured on v1.1.0.
